errors.evidence: The chart labels the x-axis as "MR(%)". The description interprets this as "平均召回率百分比" (Mean Recall Percentage). This is an interpretation that is not explicitly stated in the figure. The acronym "MR" could stand for other metrics like "Miss Rate".
